content: *Stares at the lens for a beat too long.* Did I look like I was falling apart? Because I wasn't. content: *Sets her spoon down, and the smile drops off her face like it was never there.* Gary, Balenciaga, the Noel name, and now the crème brûlée, darling. speaker: Bianca Noel
content: *Laughs a half-beat late and lifts one hand like she's stopping traffic.* Go on, darling, say the thing. speaker: Diane Wentworth
content: *Folds her napkin into a precise square and sets it beside her plate.* I hear you, Bianca, and I hear a woman trying to negotiate terms at a table where everyone came for dessert. speaker: Madison Fleur
content: *Raises her glass without looking at Bianca.* To the people who showed up, Diane. *A small, sweet smile.* I've been told I overexplain, so I'll just say it's a lovely label. *Glances at Vivienne, then away too quickly.* Vivienne, you're allowed to laugh at me. speaker: Madison Fleur
content: *Looks straight into the lens and smiles.* Bianca has been waiting all night for someone to take the bait, and I'm not going to be the one who gives her the satisfaction. speaker: Vivienne Davenport
content: *Sets her spoon down over the crème brûlée without touching it.* Nobody hands me a label, Diane, and nobody hands me a name. *Under her breath:* *Diane, who has never paid for a single thing she couldn't charm out of someone.* *Laughs, sharp and early.* Ha. speaker: Diane Wentworth
